d: At Stumps on Day 1 of the 2nd Test in Christchurch, New Zealand finished at 246/5 in 85 overs after India won the toss and elected to bowl first. India roared back in the second session as Akash Deep (2/52) and Anshul Kamboj triggered a sudden collapse, removing Latham, Henry Nicholls, and Rachin Ravindra without a single run. After slipping from 110/1 to 110/4 in the afternoon session, New Zealand recovered through resilient middle-order partnerships led by wicketkeeper-batter Tom Blundell (53*) and Glenn Phillips (36*) at Hagley Oval.
